caption: The plan page shows one plan in Indian rupees: INR 3000 per user a year or INR 325 per user a month, with Auto Renew marked Recommended. The form will not go on without a GST Number. The organization name and avatar are hidden.

The tracking defaults for new users: Monitoring and Capture Screenshot are on, and there is a Stealth Mode switch. The page says these settings only apply to users added after you save. The avatar is hidden.
By default Mera Work takes a screenshot every 5 minutes with no blur and counts idle time after 5 minutes. The avatar is hidden.
